Metadata.Name: Hello World Workflow
Metadata.Description: A simple linear workflow that fetches a random cat fact from an API, displays it in a report, and sends an email notification.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Fetch Cat Fact
Step.Description: Make a GET request to the Cat Fact Ninja API for a random cat fact

Step.Title: Display Cat Fact
Step.Description: Show the cat fact retrieved from the API in a readable format

Step.Title: Send Notification
Step.Description: Send email with the cat fact from the API response
